key_provisions_or_claims: Legal framework needed to regulate wrongs inflicted on robots, not only wrongs by robots.
Liberal argument for proscribing robotic sexual violence against sexual autonomous robots.
Legal personhood including rights against sexual violence for sexual autonomous robots.
Lethal autonomous weapons should bear a legal duty not to attack civilians, as quasi-employees of a military enterprise.
Reform strict product liability to treat LAWs as both products and persons.
annotation.summary_en: Oxford DPhil thesis arguing for legal personhood for autonomous AI. It defends legal rights for sexual autonomous robots against robotic sexual violence, and legal duties for lethal autonomous weapons as quasi-employees, plus reform of strict product liability to treat them as both products and persons.
annotation.title_clean: Robots from Venus, robots from Mars: legal personhood for autonomous AI
